correctness.rationale: The seven-state generator, Cramer resolvent identity and M-matrix denominator positivity hold for every positive extinction rate. A standalone pure-standard-library exact determinant certificate proves the cross-product factor \(\lambda q(1-q)H\) where all 159 coefficients of H are strictly positive, giving the universal sign; four independent rational Gaussian elimination examples check construction. The zero-colonization and unit-rate equality cases are addressed separately; deterministic-time stochastic dominance is unproved and not asserted.

value.rationale: The complete sharp sign law is simultaneous over the full nonnegative discount continuum, a mathematically motivated strengthening of mean metapopulation persistence. It identifies a robust optimal habitat location under exponentially timed survival assessment and settles exact equality/reversal regimes on the smallest nontrivial nonregular habitat network. It does not rely on treating a cheap special case or a numerical example as independently valuable; the 159-positive-term exact certificate supports a structural theorem.
